title: Echo Park – Assignment and Assumption of Contract No. 4194 to VanillaBlack
text:
Echo Park – Assignment and Assumption of Contract No. 4194 to VanillaBlack
  LLC for the Operation and Management of the Echo Park Boathouse Café
  Concession
summary: Approves assigning the existing contract for the Echo Park Boathouse Café concession to VanillaBlack LLC, which will operate and manage the café.

locations.text: 751 Echo Park Ave, Los Angeles, CA

flag.reason: New operator for the Echo Park Boathouse café on Echo Park Lake.
